bim.rj_intro: Ramp jump! Let's see how far they fly.
bim.rj_further: Which one jumped further? Tap its flag.
bim.rj_shorter: Which jump was shorter? Tap its flag.
bim.rj_tip_further: Look how far each flag is from the ramp.
bim.rj_order: Tap the flags in order. Shortest jump first, longest last.
bim.rj_rope: These two tracks are far apart. Tap the rope to measure the top one.
bim.rj_rope2: Now tap the rope again. It goes beside the other track.
bim.rj_which_longer: Which track is longer? Tap its flag.
bim.rj_tip_rope: Look at the end of the rope. Does the track go past it?
bim.rj_blocks: How long is the track? Tap to lay a block. Go right to the flag, with no gaps. Then tap the tick.
bim.rj_tip_blocks: The last block must just reach the flag.
bim.rj_how_many_blocks: How many blocks long is it?
bim.rj_read: How far did it jump? Read the ruler.
bim.rj_tip_read: Look straight down from the flag to the ruler.
bim.rj_place: Drag the flag to this number on the ruler. Then tap the tick.
bim.rj_tip_place: Find this number on the ruler first.
bim.rj_ruler: Slide the ruler. Put its zero right at the end.
bim.rj_read_ruler: How long is it? Read the ruler.
bim.rj_tip_ruler: Look straight down from the other end to the ruler.
bim.rj_tool: Which tool would you use to measure this?
bim.rj_tool_stick: A metre stick, for things about as big as you.
bim.rj_tool_tape: A long tape, for very long things.
bim.rj_tip_tool: Is it small, or as big as you, or very long?
bim.rj_thing_road: The whole road round the bay.
bim.rj_lay_small: Tap the small blocks to lay them all along.
bim.rj_lay_big: Now tap the big blocks to lay them along.
bim.rj_which_more: Which blocks did it take more of?
bim.rj_units_why: Small blocks, so more of them. Big blocks, so fewer.
bim.rj_how_much_further: How much further did the far one go?
bim.rj_tip_longer: Count the metres between the two flags.
bim.rj_story: Read the story, and look at the bars. How many metres?
bim.rj_tip_story: Do the bars join up, or do we want the gap?
bim.rj_plot: Put a dot above the number where it landed.
bim.rj_tip_plot: Read the number on the flag. Find it on the ruler.
bim.rj_plot_how_many: How many jumps landed on this number?
bim.rj_plot_most: Which length came up the most? Tap its number.
bim.rj_plot_total: How many jumps are there in all?
bim.rj_tip_plot_count: Each dot is one jump. Count the dots.
bim.rj_end: What a day of jumping! Thank you!
bim.rj_about_how_long: About how long was that jump? Look at the ruler. Which number is closest?
bim.rj_about_flag: Which flag is at about this number on the ruler?
bim.rj_about_place: Drag the flag to about this number on the ruler. Then tap the tick.
bim.rj_tip_about: Look straight down from the flag. Which number is closest?

noodle.wr_intro: Here comes the wall! Help the Peeps fit through the hole.
noodle.wr_picture: Which shapes make the picture in the wall? Tap them!
noodle.wr_two: Two shapes make this hole. Which two?
noodle.wr_three: This hole needs three shapes. Find them!
noodle.wr_sides: The hole has this many sides. Which shape has the same?
noodle.wr_count: How many squares will fill this hole?
noodle.wr_tip_look: Look at the hole's corners and sides. Which tile matches?
noodle.wr_tip_sides: Count the sides of the hole, then count the sides on each tile.
noodle.wr_tip_row: Find out how many fit along one row first.
